fact: The public SME agency ADEPME received ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2013 certification for its scoring and labelling unit from Bureau Veritas Sénégal in November 2021; accreditation of the certifier in Senegal is not stated and the date is over three years old.
title: Sénégal : l’ADEPME certifiée ISO 9001/2015 et ISO 27001/2013
